name: @drunkcoding/outline-openspec-mcp

tools.name: attachmentsCreate
tools.description:
Create an attachment

Creating an attachment object creates a database record and returns the inputs needed to generate a signed url and upload the file from the client to cloud storage.

HTTP: POST /attachments.create

Tags: Attachments

documentId.description: Identifier for the associated document, if any.

contentType.description: MIME type of the file attachment.

size.description: Size of the file attachment in bytes.

tools.name: attachmentsRedirect
tools.description:
Retrieve an attachment

Load an attachment from where it is stored based on the id. If the attachment is private then a temporary, signed url with embedded credentials is generated on demand.

HTTP: POST /attachments.redirect

Tags: Attachments

id.description: Unique identifier for the attachment.

tools.name: attachmentsDelete
tools.description:
Delete an attachment

Deleting an attachment is permanent. It will not delete references or links to the attachment that may exist in your documents.

HTTP: POST /attachments.delete

Tags: Attachments

id.description: Unique identifier for the attachment.

tools.name: authInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve auth

Retrieve authentication details for the current API key

HTTP: POST /auth.info

Tags: Auth

tools.name: authConfig
tools.description:
Retrieve auth config

Retrieve authentication options

HTTP: POST /auth.config

Tags: Auth

tools.name: collectionsInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve a collection

Retrieve the details of a collection by its unique identifier.

HTTP: POST /collections.info

Tags: Collections

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

tools.name: collectionsDocuments
tools.description:
Retrieve a collections document structure

Returns the document structure of a collection as a tree of navigation nodes, representing the hierarchy of documents within the collection.

HTTP: POST /collections.documents

Tags: Collections

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

tools.name: collectionsList
tools.description:
List all collections

List all collections that the authenticated user has access to.

HTTP: POST /collections.list

Tags: Collections

query.description: If set, will filter the results by collection name.

statusFilter.description: An optional array of statuses to filter by.

tools.name: collectionsCreate
tools.description:
Create a collection

Create a new collection with the specified name, description, icon, color, and permission settings. Collections are used to organize documents.

HTTP: POST /collections.create

Tags: Collections

description.description: A brief description of the collection, markdown supported.

icon.description: A string that represents an icon in the outline-icons package or an emoji

color.description: A hex color code for the collection icon

sharing.description: Whether public sharing of documents is allowed

tools.name: collectionsUpdate
tools.description:
Update a collection

Update an existing collection's properties such as name, description, icon, color, sharing settings, or permission level.

HTTP: POST /collections.update

Tags: Collections

description.description: A brief description of the collection, markdown supported.

icon.description: A string that represents an icon in the outline-icons package or an emoji

color.description: A hex color code for the collection icon

sharing.description: Whether public sharing of documents is allowed

tools.name: collectionsAddUser
tools.description:
Add a collection user

This method allows you to add a user membership to the specified collection.

HTTP: POST /collections.add_user

Tags: Collections

id.description: Identifier for the collection

userId.description: Identifier for the user to add to the collection

tools.name: collectionsRemoveUser
tools.description:
Remove a collection user

This method allows you to remove a user from the specified collection.

HTTP: POST /collections.remove_user

Tags: Collections

id.description: Identifier for the collection

userId.description: Identifier for the user to remove from the collection

tools.name: collectionsMemberships
tools.description:
List all collection memberships

This method allows you to list a collections individual memberships. It's important to note that memberships returned from this endpoint do not include group memberships.

HTTP: POST /collections.memberships

Tags: Collections

id.description: Identifier for the collection

tools.name: collectionsAddGroup
tools.description:
Add a group to a collection

This method allows you to give all members in a group access to a collection.

HTTP: POST /collections.add_group

Tags: Collections

tools.name: collectionsRemoveGroup
tools.description:
Remove a collection group

This method allows you to revoke all members in a group access to a collection. Note that members of the group may still retain access through other groups or individual memberships.

HTTP: POST /collections.remove_group

Tags: Collections

id.description: Identifier for the collection

tools.name: collectionsGroupMemberships
tools.description:
List all collection group members

This method allows you to list a collections group memberships. This is the list of groups that have been given access to the collection.

HTTP: POST /collections.group_memberships

Tags: Collections

id.description: Identifier for the collection

tools.name: collectionsDelete
tools.description:
Delete a collection

Delete a collection and all of its documents. This action can’t be undone so please be careful.

HTTP: POST /collections.delete

Tags: Collections

tools.name: collectionsExport
tools.description:
Export a collection

Triggers a bulk export of the collection in markdown format and their attachments. If documents are nested then they will be nested in folders inside the zip file. The endpoint returns a `FileOperation` that can be queried to track the progress of the export and get the url for the final file.

HTTP: POST /collections.export

Tags: Collections

tools.name: collectionsExportAll
tools.description:
Export all collections

Triggers a bulk export of multiple collections and their documents. The endpoint returns a `FileOperation` that can be queried through the fileOperations endpoint to track the progress of the export and get the url for the final file.

HTTP: POST /collections.export_all

Tags: Collections

includeAttachments.description: Whether to include attachments in the export.

includePrivate.description: Whether to include private collections in the export.

tools.name: commentsCreate
tools.description:
Create a comment

Add a comment or reply to a document, either `data` or `text` is required.

HTTP: POST /comments.create

Tags: Comments

text.description: The body of the comment in markdown.

tools.name: commentsInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve a comment

Retrieve a comment

HTTP: POST /comments.info

Tags: Comments

includeAnchorText.description: Include the document text that the comment is anchored to, if any, in the response.

tools.name: commentsUpdate
tools.description:
Update a comment

Update a comment

HTTP: POST /comments.update

Tags: Comments

tools.name: commentsDelete
tools.description:
Delete a comment

Deletes a comment. If the comment is a top-level comment, all its children will be deleted as well.

HTTP: POST /comments.delete

Tags: Comments

tools.name: commentsList
tools.description:
List all comments

This method will list all comments matching the given properties.

HTTP: POST /comments.list

Tags: Comments

includeAnchorText.description: Include the document text that the comment is anchored to, if any, in the response.

tools.description:
List all data attributes

List all data attributes.

HTTP: POST /dataAttributes.list

Update a data attribute

icon.description: An icon representing the data attribute from the outline-icons package.

Delete a data attribute

HTTP: POST /dataAttributes.delete

tools.name: documentsInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve a document

Retrieve a document by its `UUID`, `urlId`, or `shareId`. At least one of these parameters must be provided.

HTTP: POST /documents.info

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

shareId.description: Unique identifier for a document share, a shareId may be used in place of a document UUID

tools.name: documentsInsights
tools.description:
Retrieve insights for a document

Retrieve a chronologically sorted array of daily activity rollups (views, comments, reactions, revisions, editors) for a document. Insights must be enabled on the document. Defaults to the last 30 days when no date range is provided.

HTTP: POST /documents.insights

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document.

startDate.description: Start of the insights window (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days ago.

endDate.description: End of the insights window (inclusive). Defaults to today.

tools.name: documentsImport
tools.description:
Import a file as a document

This method allows you to create a new document by importing an existing file. By default a document is set to the collection root. If you want to create a nested/child document, you should pass parentDocumentId to set the parent document.

HTTP: POST /documents.import

Tags: Documents

tools.name: documentsExport
tools.description:
Export a document.

Export a document in Markdown, HTML, or PDF format. The response format is determined by the Accept header. Optionally include child documents in the export as a zip file.

HTTP: POST /documents.export

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

signedUrls.description: How long signed URLs should remain valid for attachment links (in seconds)

includeChildDocuments.description: Whether to include child documents in the export. Using this option will always return a zip file.

tools.name: documentsList
tools.description:
List all documents

This method will list all published documents and draft documents belonging to the current user.

HTTP: POST /documents.list

Tags: Documents

collectionId.description: Optionally filter to a specific collection

userId.description: Optionally filter to documents created by a specific user

statusFilter.description: Document statuses to include in results

tools.name: documentsDocuments
tools.description:
Retrieve a document's child structure

This method returns the nested document structure (tree) for the children of the specified document.

HTTP: POST /documents.documents

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

tools.name: documentsDrafts
tools.description:
List all draft documents

This method will list all draft documents belonging to the current user.

HTTP: POST /documents.drafts

Tags: Documents

dateFilter.description: Any documents that have not been updated within the specified period will be filtered out

tools.name: documentsViewed
tools.description:
List all recently viewed documents

This method will list all documents recently viewed by the current user.

HTTP: POST /documents.viewed

Tags: Documents

tools.name: documentsAnswerQuestion
tools.description:
Query documents with natural language

This method allows asking direct questions of your documents – where possible an answer will be provided. Search results will be restricted to those accessible by the current access token. Note that "AI answers" must be enabled for the workspace.

HTTP: POST /documents.answerQuestion

Tags: Documents

userId.description: Any documents that have not been edited by the user identifier will be filtered out

statusFilter.description: Any documents that are not in the specified status will be filtered out

dateFilter.description: Any documents that have not been updated within the specified period will be filtered out

tools.name: documentsSearchTitles
tools.description:
Search document titles

This method allows you to search document titles with keywords. Unlike documents.search, this only searches titles and returns faster results.

HTTP: POST /documents.search_titles

Tags: Documents

query.description: Search query to match against document titles

documentId.description: Filter results based on content within a document and its children

statusFilter.description: Document statuses to include in results

dateFilter.description: Any documents that have not been updated within the specified period will be filtered out

shareId.description: Filter results for the collection or document referenced by the shareId

sort.description: Specifies the attributes by which search results will be sorted

direction.description: Specifies the sort order with respect to sort field

tools.name: documentsSearch
tools.description:
Search all documents

This methods allows you to search your workspace's documents with keywords. Note that search results will be restricted to those accessible by the current access token.

HTTP: POST /documents.search

Tags: Documents

userId.description: Any documents that have not been edited by the user identifier will be filtered out

statusFilter.description: Document statuses to include in results

dateFilter.description: Any documents that have not been updated within the specified period will be filtered out

shareId.description: Filter results to the collection or document referenced by the shareId

snippetMinWords.description: Minimum number of words to show in search result snippets

snippetMaxWords.description: Maximum number of words to show in search result snippets

sort.description: Specifies the attributes by which search results will be sorted

direction.description: Specifies the sort order with respect to sort field

tools.name: documentsCreate
tools.description:
Create a document

This method allows you to create or publish a new document. By default a document is set to the collection root. If you want to create a nested/child document, you should pass parentDocumentId to set the parent document.

HTTP: POST /documents.create

Tags: Documents

id.description: Optional identifier for the document

text.description: The body of the document in markdown

icon.description: Icon displayed alongside the document title

color.description: Color for the document icon (hex format)

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection. Required to publish unless parentDocumentId is provided

parentDocumentId.description: Identifier for the parent document. Required to publish unless collectionId is provided

publish.description: Whether this document should be immediately published and made visible to other workspace members.

fullWidth.description: Whether the document should be displayed in full width

createdAt.description: Optionally set the created date in the past

dataAttributeId.description: Unique identifier for the data attribute.

value.description: The value of the data attribute. Can be a string, boolean, or number depending on the data attribute type.

dataAttributes.description: Data attributes to be included on the document.

tools.name: documentsUpdate
tools.description:
Update a document

This method allows you to modify an already created document

HTTP: POST /documents.update

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

text.description: The body of the document in markdown.

icon.description: Icon displayed alongside the document title

color.description: Color for the document icon (hex format)

fullWidth.description: Whether the document should be displayed in full width

templateId.description: Identifier for the template this document is based on

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection to move the document to

insightsEnabled.description: Whether insights should be visible on the document

editMode.description: The editing mode for text updates to a document. When set to `patch`, the `findText` parameter is required and the existing occurrence of `findText` will be replaced with the value of `text`.

findText.description: The text to find within the document when using `patch` editMode. This text will be replaced with the value of `text`. Required when `editMode` is `patch`.

publish.description: Whether this document should be published and made visible to other workspace members, if a draft

dataAttributeId.description: Unique identifier for the data attribute.

value.description: The value of the data attribute. Can be a string, boolean, or number depending on the data attribute type.

dataAttributes.description: Data attributes to be updated. Attributes not included will be removed from the document.

tools.name: documentsTemplatize
tools.description:
Create a template from a document

This method allows you to create a new template using an existing document as the basis

HTTP: POST /documents.templatize

Tags: Documents

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection where the template should be created

publish.description: Whether the new template should be published

tools.name: documentsUnpublish
tools.description:
Unpublish a document

Unpublishing a document moves it back to a draft status and out of the collection.

HTTP: POST /documents.unpublish

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

detach.description: Whether to detach the document from the collection

tools.name: documentsMove
tools.description:
Move a document

Move a document to a new location or collection. If no parent document is provided, the document will be moved to the collection root.

HTTP: POST /documents.move

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

index.description: The position index in the collection structure

tools.name: documentsArchive
tools.description:
Archive a document

Archiving a document allows outdated information to be moved out of sight whilst retaining the ability to optionally search and restore it later.

HTTP: POST /documents.archive

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

tools.name: documentsRestore
tools.description:
Restore a document

If a document has been archived or deleted, it can be restored. Optionally a revision can be passed to restore the document to a previous point in time.

HTTP: POST /documents.restore

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection to restore the document to.

revisionId.description: Identifier for the revision to restore to.

tools.name: documentsDelete
tools.description:
Delete a document

Deleting a document moves it to the trash. If not restored within 30 days it is permanently deleted.

HTTP: POST /documents.delete

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

permanent.description: If set to true the document will be destroyed with no way to recover rather than moved to the trash.

tools.name: documentsUsers
tools.description:
List document users

All users with access to a document. To list only users with direct membership to the document use `documents.memberships`

HTTP: POST /documents.users

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

query.description: If set, will filter the results by user name.

userId.description: If set, will filter the results to a specific user.

tools.name: documentsMemberships
tools.description:
List document memberships

Users with direct membership to a document. To list all users with access to a document use `documents.users`.

HTTP: POST /documents.memberships

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

query.description: If set, will filter the results by user name

tools.name: documentsAddUser
tools.description:
Add a document user

This method allows you to add a user membership to the specified document.

HTTP: POST /documents.add_user

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

tools.name: documentsRemoveUser
tools.description:
Remove a document user

This method allows you to remove a user membership from the specified document.

HTTP: POST /documents.remove_user

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

tools.name: documentsArchived
tools.description:
List all archived documents

This method will list all archived documents belonging to the workspace that the current user has access to.

HTTP: POST /documents.archived

Tags: Documents

collectionId.description: Optionally filter to a specific collection

tools.name: documentsDeleted
tools.description:
List all deleted documents

This method will list all deleted documents belonging to the workspace that the current user has access to.

HTTP: POST /documents.deleted

Tags: Documents

tools.name: documentsDuplicate
tools.description:
Duplicate a document

This method allows you to duplicate an existing document and optionally all of its child documents.

HTTP: POST /documents.duplicate

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

title.description: New title for the duplicated document

recursive.description: Whether child documents should also be duplicated

publish.description: Whether the new document should be published

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection the document should be copied to

parentDocumentId.description: Identifier for the parent document the document should be copied to

tools.name: documentsAddGroup
tools.description:
Add a group to a document

This method allows you to give all members in a group access to a document.

HTTP: POST /documents.add_group

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

tools.name: documentsRemoveGroup
tools.description:
Remove a group from a document

This method allows you to revoke all members in a group access to a document.

HTTP: POST /documents.remove_group

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

tools.name: documentsGroupMemberships
tools.description:
List document group memberships

This method allows you to list a document's group memberships.

HTTP: POST /documents.group_memberships

Tags: Documents

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

tools.name: documentsEmptyTrash
tools.description:
Empty trash

Permanently delete all documents in the trash. This action is irreversible. Only available to admin users.

HTTP: POST /documents.empty_trash

Tags: Documents

tools.name: eventsList
tools.description:
List all events

Events are an audit trail of important events that happen in the knowledge base.

HTTP: POST /events.list

Tags: Events

name.description: Filter to a specific event, e.g. "collections.create". Event names are in the format "objects.verb"

actorId.description: Filter to events performed by the selected user

documentId.description: Filter to events performed in the selected document

collectionId.description: Filter to events performed in the selected collection

auditLog.description: Whether to return detailed events suitable for an audit log. Without this flag less detailed event types will be returned.

tools.name: fileOperationsInfo

Retrieve the details and current status of a file operation by its unique identifier. File operations represent long-running import or export tasks.

HTTP: POST /fileOperations.info

Tags: FileOperations

id.description: Unique identifier for the file operation.

tools.name: fileOperationsDelete
tools.description:
Delete a file operation

Delete a file operation and its associated files. This is useful for cleaning up completed or failed import/export operations.

HTTP: POST /fileOperations.delete

Tags: FileOperations

id.description: Unique identifier for the file operation.

tools.name: fileOperationsRedirect
tools.description:
Retrieve the file

Load the resulting file from where it is stored based on the id. A temporary, signed url with embedded credentials is generated on demand.

HTTP: POST /fileOperations.redirect

Tags: FileOperations

id.description: Unique identifier for the file operation.

tools.name: fileOperationsList
tools.description:
List all file operations

List all file operations for the current workspace, filtered by type (import or export).

HTTP: POST /fileOperations.list

Tags: FileOperations

tools.name: groupsInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve a group

Retrieve the details of a group by its unique identifier, including its name and member count.

HTTP: POST /groups.info

Tags: Groups

id.description: Unique identifier for the group.

tools.description:
List all groups

List all groups in the workspace. Groups are used to organize users and manage permissions for collections.

HTTP: POST /groups.list

Tags: Groups

userId.description: Filter to groups including a specific user

externalId.description: Filter to groups matching an external ID

query.description: Filter to groups matching a search query

tools.name: groupsCreate
tools.description:
Create a group

Create a new group with the specified name. Groups can be used to organize users and assign collection permissions to multiple users at once.

HTTP: POST /groups.create

Tags: Groups

tools.name: groupsUpdate
tools.description:
Update a group

Update an existing group's name. The group is identified by its unique identifier.

HTTP: POST /groups.update

Tags: Groups

tools.name: groupsDelete
tools.description:
Delete a group

Deleting a group will cause all of its members to lose access to any collections the group has previously been added to. This action can’t be undone so please be careful.

HTTP: POST /groups.delete

Tags: Groups

tools.name: groupsMemberships
tools.description:
List all group members

List and filter all the members in a group.

HTTP: POST /groups.memberships

Tags: Groups

id.description: Group id

tools.name: groupsAddUser
tools.description:
Add a group member

This method allows you to add a user to the specified group.

HTTP: POST /groups.add_user

Tags: Groups

id.description: Identifier for the group

userId.description: Identifier for the user to add to the group

tools.name: groupsRemoveUser
tools.description:
Remove a group member

This method allows you to remove a user from the group.

HTTP: POST /groups.remove_user

Tags: Groups

id.description: Identifier for the group

userId.description: Identifier for the user to remove from the group

tools.name: oauthClientsInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve an OAuth client

To retrieve information about an OAuth client you must pass either an `id` or a `clientId`.

HTTP: POST /oauthClients.info

Tags: OAuthClients

id.description: Unique identifier for the OAuth client.

clientId.description: Public identifier for the OAuth client.

tools.name: oauthClientsList
tools.description:
List accessible OAuth clients

List all OAuth clients that the authenticated user has access to. This includes both clients created by the user and published clients available to the workspace.

HTTP: POST /oauthClients.list

Tags: OAuthClients

tools.name: oauthClientsCreate
tools.description:
Create an OAuth client

Create a new OAuth client application that can be used to authenticate users and access the API on their behalf.

HTTP: POST /oauthClients.create

Tags: OAuthClients

description.description: A short description of this OAuth client.

developerName.description: The name of the developer who created this OAuth client.

developerUrl.description: The URL of the developer who created this OAuth client.

avatarUrl.description: A URL pointing to an image representing the OAuth client.

redirectUris.description: List of redirect URIs for the OAuth client.

published.description: Whether the OAuth client is available to other workspaces.

tools.name: oauthClientsUpdate
tools.description:
Update an OAuth client

Update an existing OAuth client's properties such as name, description, redirect URIs, or published status.

HTTP: POST /oauthClients.update

Tags: OAuthClients

id.description: Unique identifier for the OAuth client.

description.description: A short description of this OAuth client.

developerName.description: The name of the developer who created this OAuth client.

developerUrl.description: The URL of the developer who created this OAuth client.

avatarUrl.description: A URL pointing to an image representing the OAuth client.

redirectUris.description: List of redirect URIs for the OAuth client.

published.description: Whether the OAuth client is available to other workspaces.

tools.name: oauthClientsRotateSecret
tools.description:
Rotate the secret for an OAuth client

Generate a new client secret for an OAuth client. The old secret will be invalidated immediately, so ensure your application is updated to use the new secret.

HTTP: POST /oauthClients.rotate_secret

Tags: OAuthClients

id.description: Unique identifier for the OAuth client.

tools.name: oauthClientsDelete
tools.description:
Delete an OAuth client

Permanently delete an OAuth client and revoke all associated access tokens. This action cannot be undone.

HTTP: POST /oauthClients.delete

Tags: OAuthClients

id.description: Unique identifier for the OAuth client.

tools.name: oauthAuthenticationsList
tools.description:
List accessible OAuth authentications

List all OAuth authentications for the current user. These represent the third-party applications that the user has authorized to access their account.

HTTP: POST /oauthAuthentications.list

Tags: OAuthAuthentications

tools.name: oauthAuthenticationsDelete
tools.description:
Delete an OAuth authentiation

Revoke an OAuth authentication, removing the third-party application's access to the user's account.

HTTP: POST /oauthAuthentications.delete

Tags: OAuthAuthentications

tools.name: revisionsInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve a revision

A revision is a snapshot of a document at a specific point in time. This endpoint allows you to retrieve a specific version of a document by its unique identifier.

HTTP: POST /revisions.info

Tags: Revisions

id.description: Unique identifier for the revision.

tools.name: revisionsList
tools.description:
List all revisions

List all revisions for a specific document. Revisions represent historical snapshots of a document's content and can be used to track changes over time.

HTTP: POST /revisions.list

Tags: Revisions

documentId.description: The document ID to retrieve revisions for

tools.name: sharesInfo
tools.description:
Retrieve a share object

Retrieve the details of a share link by its unique identifier or by the associated document ID. Shares allow documents to be accessed publicly or by specific users.

HTTP: POST /shares.info

Tags: Shares

id.description: Unique identifier for the share.

documentId.description: Unique identifier for a document. One of id or documentId must be provided.

tools.name: sharesList
tools.description:
List all shares

List all share links in the workspace.

HTTP: POST /shares.list

Tags: Shares

query.description: Filter to shared documents matching a search query

tools.name: sharesCreate
tools.description:
Create a share

Creates a new share link that can be used by to access a document or collection. If you request multiple shares for the same resource with the same API key, the same share object will be returned.
